items.p: Twenty years in space, and every material on it had to keep working the whole time. At the end, NASA flew it into Saturn so it couldn't crash into Enceladus or Titan, two moons that might support life.

items.h: Rocky and Grace, from Project Hail Mary
items.p: A science fiction novel about a human and an alien who have no language in common and save both of their planets with science and math.

items.h: Where Do We Come From? What Are We? Where Are We Going?
items.p: The question I'd like my work to sit underneath.
